summary: A single-line text field for data entry, styled with the terminal focus ring.
purpose: Use for any freeform text or number entry inside a form. Reach for it instead of a raw MUI TextField so the focus ring, border colors, and monospace option come from tokens.

anatomy.description: The field label; monospace, small, shifts to the action color on focus.
The entry area with a tinted surface fill and a notched outline.
A token-driven glow applied when the field is focused.

props.name: variant
props.description: The MUI field style; outlined is the system default.

props.name: monospace
props.description: Render the entered value in the monospace font for a code or terminal feel.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label; inherited from TextField. Always provide one for accessibility.

props.name: error
props.description: Mark the field invalid; inherited from TextField.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting or error text below the field; inherited from TextField.

props.name: ...TextFieldProps
props.description: All MUI TextField props except variant pass through (multiline, type, fullWidth, name, and more).

variants.name: outlined
variants.description: Notched outline with a tinted fill.

variants.name: filled
variants.whenToUse: When you want more visual weight than outlined.

whenToUse: Collecting a short freeform value such as a name, email, or number.
Any single-line field inside a form.

whenNotToUse.scenario: A conversational message box that sends on submit
Choosing from a fixed set of options

do: Always pass a label so the field is announced to assistive tech.
Use monospace only for code, IDs, or terminal-style values.
Surface validation through error and helperText together.
dont: Use a placeholder as the only label.
Hardcode border or focus colors; they come from tokens.

content.voice: Labels are short and literal. Helper text is plain and specific about what went wrong.
rules: Error text names the fix, not just the failure.

tokensUsed.usage: Value font in the default mode.
Value font when monospace is set, and the label font.
Field fill, at half alpha resting and full on focus.
Outline and label color on focus.

aria: The label is associated with the field via MUI.
error sets aria-invalid; helperText is linked as the description.
accessibility.contrast: Value and label clear 4.5:1 against the field fill; the focus ring is visible against the background.
accessibility.focus: Focus applies the token focus ring and shifts the outline and label to the action color.

related.whenToChoose: Use ChatInput for a send-on-submit message box; Input is the general form field.
